name: Skywhale Balloon Regatta
description: A whimsical regatta where enormous hot-air balloons shaped like whales drift above a golden cloud sea at sunset.
prompt: A single whimsical wide-angle image of a sky regatta at golden hour: enormous hot-air balloons shaped like gentle blue whales, their translucent fabric glowing with sunset light, floating above a rolling sea of peach and lavender clouds. Tiny sailboats suspended beneath some balloons, ropes and rigging, distant flock of birds, warm sun flare, painterly realism, highly detailed, dreamy atmosphere, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: Set sail for the sunset cloud sea — where whales don’t swim, they float. 🐋☁️ Would you ride in one?
